title: The Watchful Ant
summary: A clever ant warns its people so they are saved from the army of Prophet Sulaiman 'alaihis salam. (QS. An-Naml: 18-19)
moral: Caring for others and daring to warn them is noble. And be thankful for every blessing from Allah.
pages: Prophet Sulaiman 'alaihis salam was a prophet granted the ability to understand the language of animals. One day he walked with his great army, made up of jinn, humans, and birds.
In a quiet valley lived a colony of ants. They worked together busily carrying food to their nest, humming softly.
Suddenly an ant saw dust rising in the distance. The ground trembled slightly. A great army was heading toward their valley!
Loudly the ant called out, 'O ants, enter your dwellings! Do not let Sulaiman and his army crush you while they are unaware.'
Prophet Sulaiman heard the ant's words and smiled gently. He prayed, 'My Lord, guide me to always be grateful for Your blessings and to do righteous deeds that please You.'
The army stepped carefully and turned away around the valley. The ants stayed safe in their nest, and their little garden was not trampled at all.
From this story we learn: to care for others, to dare to warn, and to always be grateful to Allah. Even a creature as small as an ant can be an example. The end.
